source_admission: Published values used in parameters.py, run.py and README.md. Each was read for this study on 2026-10-11 by read-only literature passes whose notes, with the verbatim passages, are kept on the research drive (provisioning-runs/food_systems/lit_*.json); 'values_used' gives each parameter's value as parameters.py takes it from the source; 'access' records how far each source was read: full text, abstract only, or a fetch tool's summary quoting the text. No outside dataset or full paper is committed. Earth measurements and models serve as reference points for the Moon's engineered systems.
